workflows.name: Installation and Onboarding Flow
steps: User installs extension
Background service worker sw.js initializes
Sets local and sessionStorage isBGInitialized flags
Sends onboarding daily-ping to gnar.grammarly.com

workflows.name: Real-time Text Correction Flow
steps: User types text inside text fields on any supported webpage
Content script Grammarly-check.js intercepts inputs and tracks mutations
Dispatches text payloads via chrome.runtime.sendMessage to Background sw.js
Background initiates secure connection over wss://capi.grammarly.com/fpws

items.data_description: User-typed character input, words, sentences, and document texts harvested from text inputs and contenteditables
items.source: User keyboard interaction and DOM elements on target webpage
items.operation: Read from page DOM and transmitted over network
items.collection_trigger: User types characters or character mutation occurs in active text fields
items.user_control_or_consent: Enabled by default upon installation. Users can disable Grammarly on specific sites via the widget settings
items.purpose_observed: Core functionality - spellchecking, tone adjustments, grammar corrections, and AI re-writing

items.data_description: Active tab URL, page host domain, and browser tab navigation events
items.source: Chrome Tabs API and window location properties
items.operation: Queried by extension and transmitted via telemetry
items.collection_trigger: Tab loaded, focus updated, or focus lost
local_processing: Identify if Grammarly is enabled on domain
items.user_control_or_consent: No explicit consent, passive collection upon visiting domains
items.purpose_observed: Validate if domain is supported and fetch appropriate treatment configuration

items.data_description: User login token, unique userId, and premium subscription identifiers
items.operation: Queried from cookies / storage and sent to synchronize state
items.collection_trigger: On startup, account login, or sidepanel open
items.user_control_or_consent: User initiates login via popup/options page
items.purpose_observed: Account authentication, cloud profile sync, premium feature activation

privacy.minimization: The extension actively minimizes exfiltration by allowing domain exclusions (such as Outlook, Gmail, Slack, Facebook by default) and avoids logging inside designated password or card fields.
privacy.consent: Implicit agreement upon installing the extension. Explicit login is required only for personal cloud documents and premium features.
privacy.retention: Document text cache in IndexedDB persists until manual logout. Analytics telemetry is stored on Grammarly servers subject to their central retention policies.

third_parties.name: Sentry
third_parties.purpose: Dispatches runtime logs and client exception telemetry

third_parties.name: Iterable
third_parties.purpose: Delivers user engagement messaging and onboarding logs

privacy.policy_compliance: Fully compliant with Chrome Web Store user data guidelines by requiring user-initiated action for authentication and providing site-level toggle controls.

risks.justification: Intercepts user character keystrokes and document inputs from webpage inputs and relays them in real-time to third-party WebSocket endpoints (wss://capi.grammarly.com).
Continuously monitors browser URL patterns, active tab domains, and telemetry rate counts, batched and dispatched periodically to analytics collection endpoints.
Requests permissive broad host permissions (http://*/*, https://*/*) granting the extension background engine full script injection access on all visited websites.
